verdict.rationale: Dover documents reusable feedback forms that are created once and assigned to interview stages, so every interviewer on that stage uses the same scorecard. This covers the stage-plus-reusable-form core of the story. Its AI-suggested questions are generated per candidate, which is not a reusable question bank. missing for 10: a reusable question bank defined per role, per-interviewer focus areas or assignments, explicit documentation of a role-level interview plan template, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, each role carries an interview plan — stages, question banks, and per-interviewer focus areas defined once and reused

citations.quote: Create a form once, assign it to an interview stage, and every interviewer scores candidates the same way.
It shows the candidate's details, their resume, and the feedback form assigned to the interview stage.
